text: The D 3 -creatine dilution method was initially validated in rodents, showing a strong relationship with estimates of lean tissue mass ( r = .96) (83). A follow-up study demonstrated the method could be employed repeatedly over time to accurately measure lean tissue changes in growing rats (84). Collectively, the findings show promise for D 3 -creatine dilution as an assessment tool.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 3: The Measurement of Muscle Hypertrophy
